div.head: Northu 55
div.ab: Sunnandæges cypinge we forbeodað æghwar ⁊ ælc folcgemot ⁊ ælc weorc ⁊ ælce lade ægðer ge on wæne ge on horse ge on byrdene.
Sunday market we forbid everywhere, and every public assembly and all work and all carrying [of goods], whether by wagon or by horse or on one's back.
We everywhere forbid trade on a Sunday and every public meeting and every type of labour and every type of transport, either by wagon or by horse or by carried load.
Sonntags-Kaufhandel verbieten wir überall und jedes Volksversammlungs-Gericht und jede Arbeit und jeden Transport einer Ladung, sowohl zu Wagen, wie zu Pferde, wie als Tragelast.
We forbid Sunday trading everywhere, and every popular assembly [court], and all work, and all carrying of loads, whether by wagon or on horseback or as a burden carried.
div.note: Liebermann compares I Cn 15 and EGu 7.1.
